title: RetroTS.py
description: Creates slice-based regressors for regressing out components of heart rate, respiration, and respiration volume per time using independent data files or BIDS formatted files.

phys_fs.description: Physiological signal sampling frequency in Hz
phys_fs.title: Physiological Sampling Frequency

phys_file.description: BIDS formatted physio file in tab-separated format, can be gzipped
phys_file.title: BIDS Physio File

phys_json.description: BIDS formatted physio metadata json file. If not specified, the json corresponding to the phys_file will be loaded.
phys_json.title: BIDS Physio JSON

rvt_shifts.description: Vector of shifts in seconds of RVT signal. (default is [0:5:20])
rvt_shifts.title: RVT Shifts

rvt_out.description: Flag for writing RVT regressors (default is 1)
rvt_out.title: Write RVT Regressors Flag

resp_cutoff_freq.description: Cut-off frequency in Hz for respiratory lowpass filter (default 3 Hz)
resp_cutoff_freq.title: Respiratory Cut-off Frequency

cardiac_cutoff_freq.description: Cut-off frequency in Hz for cardiac lowpass filter (default 3 Hz)
cardiac_cutoff_freq.title: Cardiac Cut-off Frequency

cardiac_out.description: Flag for writing Cardiac regressors (default is 1)
cardiac_out.title: Write Cardiac Regressors Flag

respiration_out.description: Flag for writing Respiratory regressors (default is 1)
respiration_out.title: Write Respiratory Regressors Flag

quiet.description: Show talkative progress as the program runs (default is 1)
quiet.title: Quiet Mode

show_graphs.description: Show graphs (default is unset; set with any parameter to view)
show_graphs.title: Show Graphs

debug.description: Drop into pdb upon an exception (default is False)
debug.title: Debug Flag

slice_offset.description: Vector of slice acquisition time offsets in seconds (default is equivalent of alt+z)
slice_offset.title: Slice Offset

slice_order.description: Slice timing information in seconds. (default is alt+z)
slice_order.title: Slice Order

legacy_transform.description: Specify the version of the original Matlab code's transformation (default is 0)
legacy_transform.title: Legacy Transform
